resolution.note: Dev replay on harness f4dd015 (.krn/runs/d23-comparison/stopgate/run1): 5/7 previously abandoned K units now commit (434 470 547 566 606; were 0/7); 467 and 586 end with a stated-blocker escape on invalid units (other-repo task; task delivered before parent), follow-up task filed; zero runs ended by a Stop refusal (all end_turn, claude_exit 0).

title: A K worker cannot finish without a commit and its scoped related tests green
body:
Why: 7 n100 K runs ended without a commit (4 under 40 s, e.g. 467 one tool call then end_turn); scoped regression-test selection given to the agent measured +5 pp at lower cost (TestPrune, arxiv 2510.18270). Evidence: .krn/runs/d23-comparison/research-2.md.
Outcome: the lane brief names the related test command (tests importing the scoped files); a Stop check in worker sessions refuses to end while there is no commit or that command is red, with one explicit escape for a stated blocker.
Proof: unit test of the related-test selector and of the Stop check (no commit -> refuse; red -> refuse; green commit -> allow); D23 dev replay shows zero K runs without a commit and no refusal-ended runs.
Scope: src/cli/, scripts/claude/, evals/d23/, test/.
